selected_evidence.summary: Collector configuration validated; rsyslog is active and listening on node1's managed IP on TCP/514.
Sender configuration validated, rsyslog is active, and an established TCP session to node1 was observed.
The required file contains the baseline message and messages generated after each node restart.

Healthy baseline captured; restart acknowledged; boot ID changed from f1afbc7f-689a-477e-99b4-358a1d1d8226 to 3cceadf6-7cb0-4297-91c1-b17d7cc2bd5e; listener, firewall rule, retained data, and new ingestion recovered.

Healthy baseline captured; restart acknowledged; boot ID changed from 6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76 to 26fbe5f5-6946-4298-8964-b0b516c0d75b; rsyslog, TCP forwarding, and post-restart persistence recovered.
